test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"They can be delivering the goods tomorrow."

options.text: The goods can be being delivered tomorrow.
The goods shall be delivering tomorrow.
The goods can be delivered tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "They can be delivering the goods tomorrow."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the goods" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "can be delivering" to "can be being delivered" (present possibility passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "tomorrow" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The goods can be being delivered tomorrow."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The goods shall be delivering tomorrow." – Incorrect tense and structure.
 
• **Option 3: **"The goods can deliver tomorrow." – Incorrect voice (active instead of passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The goods can be delivered tomorrow." – Incorrect form; does not match the continuous aspect of the original sentence.
